record_note: XZL (ACRO-HT/ACRO-BT stapled trust) discloses DPS 'before retention' (1.772) and 'after retention' (1.595) only as full-year totals in the Statement of Distributable Income; no dated H1 2024 tranche with its own rate is printed anywhere in the AR. The only dated tranche disclosed is the Subsequent Events approval of 0.848 US cents for 1 Jul-31 Dec 2024 (declared 27 Feb 2025, paid 28 Mar 2025). The implied H1 2024 rate (~0.747, = 1.595 - 0.848) is never itself printed with a period, so per the no-invention rule it is NOT reported as a tranche. A cash_paid tranche for the prior period paid during FY2024 (presumably 2H2023) is also not reported because its rate/dates are not disclosed in this AR (only the FY2023 aggregate DPS of 3.430 is shown).

Same disclosure pattern as FY2024: only the full-year DPS totals (0.944 before retention, 0.850 after retention) and one Subsequent Events tranche (0.418 US cents, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2025, declared 26 Feb 2026, paid 30 Mar 2026) are printed with dates. The cash_paid entry (0.848 cents, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2024) is the prior year's subsequent-event tranche, actually paid on 28 Mar 2025 within this FY2025 period (cited from the FY2024 report, line 5967, since this FY2025 report does not re-print its rate/period). No dated H1 2025 tranche (implied ~0.432 = 0.850 - 0.418) is printed anywhere in this AR, so it is not reported per the no-invention rule.

O5RU (AIMS APAC REIT) ends 31 March. This folder is labelled FY2024 but the report is for the financial year ended 31 March 2025 (declared FY2024 per the offset-reporter convention). Quarterly tranches taken from the Distribution Statements note; the final quarter (1 Jan-31 Mar 2025) is disclosed only in Subsequent Events (approved 7 May 2025, paid 25 Jun 2025). Accrual sum matches headline DPU exactly.

This folder is labelled FY2025 but, consistent with the batch note, its columns are headed 2026 -- the report is for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 (declared FY2025 per the offset-reporter convention). Quarterly tranches taken from the Distribution Statements note; the final quarter (1 Jan-31 Mar 2026) is disclosed only in Subsequent Events (approved 7 May 2026, ~S$21.3m, paid 29 Jun 2026, payable in cash or via the Distribution Reinvestment Plan). Accrual sum matches headline DPU exactly.

M1GU (Sabana/Alpha Integrated REIT) applies ~10% retention to the opening amount available for distribution, not to individual tranche rates; tranche rates themselves are unaffected. The 2H 2024 tranche (1.52 cents, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2024) is stated in the FY highlights narrative (line 844) and results-calendar (payment date 28 Feb 2025, per the calendar table) but its dollar amount is not printed in this FY2024 report (only in the following year's comparative Distribution Statement, $17,101,000) -- amount left null here since not disclosed in this report. DRP-issued units (13,266,912 units, ~$4,880,000) were part-payment of the FY2023 H2 cash_paid tranche; this does not change that tranche's rate or period. Accrual sum matches headline declared DPU of 2.86 cents.

2H 2025 tranche rate (1.83 cents) is stated only in the FY highlights narrative (line 986: 'This comprised the payout of 1H 2025 DPU of 1.70 cents and 2H 2025 DPU of 1.83 cents'); no separate Subsequent Events note with a declaration date, pay date, or dollar amount for this tranche was found anywhere in this AR (the document has no 'SUBSEQUENT EVENTS' section this year), so those fields are left null. No retention was applied for FY2025 (note (2) to the Distribution Statement: 'nil' retained). Accrual sum matches headline declared DPU of 3.53 cents.

BMGU (BHG Retail REIT) declares semi-annually. The 2H 2024 tranche (0.25 cents, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2024) is disclosed only in Subsequent Events, declared 26 Feb 2025; the AR states it 'will be paid within 90 days from the end of the distribution period' per the Trust Deed but gives no exact pay date or dollar amount, so both are left null. Accrual sum matches headline DPU of 0.50 cents exactly.

Same semi-annual pattern as FY2024. The 2H 2025 tranche (0.07 cents, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2025) is disclosed only in Subsequent Events, declared 27 Feb 2026; no exact pay date or dollar amount is given. Accrual sum matches headline DPU of 0.29 cents exactly.
